public_open_space.name: 525 Market St
public_open_space.location: Located along Market Street, at the building's side just southwest of main entrance.
public_open_space.description: This is a two level open space, with granite wall water fountains at the sidewalk level near Market Street and a view to the landscaped space on the second level.
public_open_space.landscaping: Plant wall, water feature, abundant street trees, some turf on terraced steps.
public_open_space.seating: 168' platform/box seating, 164' terraced steps, ~80 sq. ft. of turf, 11 tables with 44 movable chairs
public_open_space.designer: PWP Landscape Architecture and Shed Landscape Architect
